function buildItems(sw){
  const items = [];
  const zRange = R + HALF_H * Math.abs(sinT) + 30;
  const fogOf = z => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.5 + 0.5 * z / zRange));
  const glowOf = y3 => sw === null ? 0 : Math.exp(-((y3 - sw) * (y3 - sw)) / 3528); // 2*42^2 = 3528
  // axis dashes
  const M = 30;
  for (let k = 0; k < M; k += 2){
    const y0 = -HALF_H + (k / M) * 2 * HALF_H;
    const y1 = -HALF_H + ((k + 1) / M) * 2 * HALF_H;
    const a0 = projXY(0, y0, 0), a1 = projXY(0, y1, 0);
    items.push({kind:'axis', z:(a0.z + a1.z) / 2, fog: fogOf((a0.z + a1.z) / 2), g: 0,
                px0:a0.x, py0:a0.y, px1:a1.x, py1:a1.y});
  }
  // ruler ticks every 5 bp
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i += 5){
    const y3 = (i - (N - 1) / 2) * DY;
    const t = projXY(0, y3, 0);
    items.push({kind:'tick', z:t.z, fog:fogOf(t.z), g:glowOf(y3) * 0.5, x:t.x, y:t.y, u:t.s, major: i % 10 === 0});
  }
  // backbone
  for (let st = 0; st < 2; st++){
    const P = st ? pB : pA;
    for (let i = 0; i < N - 1; i++){
      const z = (P[i].z + P[i + 1].z) / 2 - 0.5;
      const ym = (i + 0.5 - (N - 1) / 2) * DY;
      items.push({kind:'seg', st, i, z, fog:fogOf(z), g:glowOf(ym)});
    }
  }
  // rungs
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++){
    const z = (pA[i].z + pB[i].z) / 2 - 0.25;
    const y3 = (i - (N - 1) / 2) * DY;
    items.push({kind:'rung', i, z, fog:fogOf(z), g:glowOf(y3)});
  }
  // nodes
  for (let st = 0; st < 2; st++){
    const P = st ? pB : pA;
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++){
      const y3 = (i - (N - 1) / 2) * DY;
      items.push({kind:'node', st, i, z:P[i].z + 1.5, fog:fogOf(P[i].z), g:glowOf(y3)});
    }
  }
  items.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);
  return items;
}
